summary: E4 skip + E1 fresh-PR pre-check key on rev-list commit count; rebase/squash merges leave landed branches 'ahead' forever, so idempotent re-entry post-merge spins a duplicate PR instead of skipping
evidence: SKILL.md ~L10519 (Idempotent bullet) + ~L12160 (E1 aheadness arm): git rev-list --count origin/main..issue-<N> counts COMMITS, not novel patches. Default merge forms (--rebase experiments, --squash infra) land COPIES, so a fully-merged branch reads count>0 forever: (a) the epm:merged skip is near-inert post-merge; (b) crash-between-merge-and-marker re-entry now creates a fresh draft PR + gate re-run + empty-content merge attempt where the old flow reposted success on the real merge. Bounded (PR churn/noise, never payload loss or false success on unlanded payload); predicate is verbatim plan A4/A1. Fix sketch: patch-aware novelty via git cherry origin/main issue-<N> | grep -q '^+' at both sites.
